findings.evidence: PatchSdkHost rejects an unissued direct forged handle but reconciles a post-dispatch second-effect fence failure to its durable pending record; phase_11_contract_test exercises the two-effect Docker journal with exactly one committed effect.
findings.rationale: Preserve direct forged-handle rejection while reconciling pending or terminal durable truth after a dispatched effect fence failure.

findings.evidence: Authenticated persistent lease authority is durable across a real calling-process restart; exact resource/domain labels and a host-only Docker guard reject wrong key/domain/live attachment. The final exact receipt passed the subprocess regression and all Phase 11 Docker tests.
findings.rationale: A cold process can reclaim only exact authenticated idle state; foreign, mismatched, or live volumes remain unavailable and are never deleted.

findings.evidence: Container startup tracks authenticated newly-created ownership and removes it only after create/copy/bootstrap/attach/attestation failure; retry, foreign-label, and live-attachment disposal cases are covered in phase_11_contract_test.
findings.rationale: Only newly-created authenticated owned volumes may be removed; partial or foreign volumes may never attach or be deleted.

findings.rationale: Both the normal sub-root write and the revalidated root race are covered without widening workspace authority.
